ns2:section.sectionText: Interdisciplinary Methods in Research Computing addresses technical and soft skills in managing computer-based research. Relevant to both technical and newly technical student researchers from disciplines across campus. This course will cover data management; process management and task automation; and research project management. Topics include data organization in spreadsheets, document revision control, data visualization, robust testing strategies, and reproducibility. Meets with IS 497 IM3, IS 497 IM4, and ENG 498 IM.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
